summary: A class defines a new type with its own fields. new creates an object from the class and runs its constructor.
notes: String name; declares a field. Every Student object has its own name.
public Student() is the default constructor. It has the same name as the class and no return type.
maya.name = "Maya" changes only maya. jordan keeps its own empty name.
pitfall: Writing public void Student() turns the constructor into an ordinary method, so new Student() never runs it and name stays null.
